title: Anthropic IPO Targets $1.4 Trillion Valuation, Six Times Oversubscribed Ahead of Nasdaq Debut
summary: Anthropic's IPO is six times oversubscribed at a $1.4 trillion valuation ahead of its Nov 19 Nasdaq debut, testing the AI trade amid Nvidia turmoil and $4.2T in sector losses.

# Anthropic IPO Targets $1.4 Trillion Valuation, Six Times Oversubscribed Ahead of Nasdaq Debut


By OpenTools Team


·


November 16, 2026


Anthropic's IPO is already six times oversubscribed just three days into its roadshow, targeting a $1.4 trillion valuation ahead of its Thursday Nasdaq debut. The listing lands in the middle of an Nvidia leadership crisis and a broader AI stock rout that has erased $4.2 trillion from picks‑and‑shovels AI firms since June.


## The Numbers: $1.4 Trillion and Six Times Oversubscribed


[Anthropic](https://opentools.ai/organizations/anthropic) 's roadshow kicked off November 10, and within three days institutional investor orders hit six times the offering size, according to[Semafor](https://www.semafor.com/article/11/15/2026/anthropic-ipo-set-to-define-ai-trade) . That pace outstripped even SpaceX's early roadshow, which reached 2x oversubscription by day two,[The Chosun](https://www.chosun.com/english/industry-en/2026/11/16/2ORJSH73K5HCDOE33CHCJP2CEI/) reported, citing multiple sources. The company is targeting a valuation of up to $1.4 trillion with an offering of approximately $64.4 billion. Pricing is expected to finalize November 18, with the Nasdaq debut under ticker ANT on November 19.


## Nvidia's Shadow: A $10 Billion Bet on a Troubled Partner


The timing is delicate.[Nvidia](https://opentools.ai/organizations/nvidia) reports earnings on Tuesday, November 17, two days before[Anthropic](https://opentools.ai/organizations/anthropic) 's Thursday listing — and the chipmaker is reeling from the sudden resignation of CEO Jensen Huang after revelations of an affair with a suspected Chinese spy.[Semafor](https://www.semafor.com/article/11/15/2026/anthropic-ipo-set-to-define-ai-trade) reports that Anthropic is expecting a $10 billion investment from Nvidia immediately after its IPO, and that Anthropic has already diversified its hardware suppliers beyond Nvidia. One investor told the outlet that Nvidia and Anthropic's future are now **more intertwined than ever before** , and that less-than-stellar Nvidia earnings could inject real uncertainty ahead of the debut.


## The Bigger Picture: $4.2 Trillion Erased From AI Stocks


[Anthropic](https://opentools.ai/organizations/anthropic) 's IPO lands in the middle of a brutal stretch for AI infrastructure stocks. Since June, **picks-and-shovels AI firms have shed $4.2 trillion in market value** , according to[Semafor](https://www.semafor.com/article/11/15/2026/anthropic-ipo-set-to-define-ai-trade) . But the S&P 500 snapped its four-week losing streak last week, and the iShares Semiconductor ETF bounced 9.3% despite Huang's resignation. The question for investors: does Anthropic's listing mark the bottom of the AI selloff, or is it a top signal for a sector that has not yet finished deflating?


## Can Claude Grow Beyond Coding?


Investors are not just betting on an IPO — they are betting that Claude can expand beyond its core strength in coding into office productivity and professional knowledge work, where[The Chosun](https://www.chosun.com/english/industry-en/2026/11/16/2ORJSH73K5HCDOE33CHCJP2CEI/) reports the real revenue lies. If competitors like[OpenAI](https://opentools.ai/organizations/openai) release models with similar benchmark performance,[Anthropic](https://opentools.ai/organizations/anthropic) must prove it can command premium pricing anyway. Revenue projections from global investment banks show a steep ramp — from roughly $500 million this year to $1.4 billion next year and $2.7 billion by 2028, though some investors who passed on the offering expect 2028 revenue to come in 30% below those estimates.


## Dario Amodei Becomes the Face of the AI Boom


The IPO transforms[Anthropic](https://opentools.ai/organizations/anthropic) CEO Dario Amodei from a safety-focused researcher into the public face of the AI industry. According to[Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/features/2026-11-15/anthropic-s-ipo-makes-dario-amodei-the-new-face-of-the-ai-boom) , Anthropic is about to become the world's most valuable AI stock, putting Amodei at the center of an industry at a crossroads. While[OpenAI](https://opentools.ai/organizations/openai) is burning cash with an adjusted operating margin of negative 109%, Anthropic's is roughly 15% positive — a difference that institutional investors are watching closely. The company's dual-class share structure, however, means public shareholders will have little say over the company's direction, as detailed in Anthropic's November 10 IPO filing.


## What Happens Next


The week ahead is packed with AI market catalysts.


- **Tuesday, Nov 18** Nvidia reports Q3 earnings — the first quarterly report since Huang's ouster. A miss could rattle Anthropic's IPO pricing.


- **Tuesday, Nov 18** Anthropic finalizes offering price after institutional roadshow wraps.


- **Thursday, Nov 19** Nasdaq debut under ticker ANT. The biggest IPO in history goes live.


- **Post-IPO** Nvidia's $10 billion investment hits Anthropic's balance sheet.
